BUSINESS SEGMENTS -- FROM THE FILING
Other

No single segment can be named from the stored filing text for this finding.

Total net sales were €32.7bn in 2025 versus €28.3bn in 2024.

Source

Net system sales were €24.5bn in 2025 versus €21.8bn in 2024.

Source

Net service and field option sales were €8.2bn in 2025 versus €6.5bn in 2024.

Source

In Logic, net sales increased by €2.9 billion, primarily driven by leading-edge foundry growth in support of strong AI demand.

Source

In Memory, net sales decreased by €0.2 billion, reflecting a continuation of high Memory demand following strong growth in 2024.

Source

ASML recognized four EXE and 44 NXE systems in sales in 2025 compared to two EXE and 42 NXE systems in 2024.

Source

Customers in China represented 29.1% of 2025 total net sales and 36.1% of 2024 net sales.

Source

Taiwan customers represented 25.5% of 2025 total net sales versus 15.4% in 2024.

Source

Customers in South Korea represented 25.0% of 2025 total net sales and 22.7% of 2024 total net sales.

Source

One customer group accounted for €7,796.7 million, or 23.9% of total net sales in 2025, versus €4,682.4 million or 16.6% in 2024, and 38.0% of 2025 sales went to the two largest customers.

Source
DUV system

DUV system sales decreased from 374 units in 2024 to 279 in 2025.

Source
Lithography system unit

Lithography system unit sales were 327 units in 2025, 418 units in 2024 and 449 units in 2023.

Source

From the 20-F filed February 25th, 2026.
